edge_explainer: No crash - zero >7% days in four months. A cumulative grind: -40.9% from the 2024-01-29 3y high on the perpetual/maintenance licence melt after the Micro Focus digestion, divestitures that shrink the base (AMC 2024; Vertica $150M announced 02-02, closed 05-11), and a CEO change (Ayman Antoun, 01-29-2026). PATH EXHAUSTED: the 52w low of 19.77 was set 2026-06-22, just 42 days ago, and the stock is +32.0% off it. THE CORRECTION THAT MATTERS - the queue note's '14% FCF yield' is measured on equity, not on the enterprise. TTM FCF $809.5M; equity market cap $6,325M -> 12.8%; but total debt $6,414M less cash $1,254M = $5,160M net debt -> EV $11.48B -> FCF/EV = 7.1%. At ~2.9x net-debt/EBITDA the 12.8% equity yield IS the 7.1% asset yield plus financial leverage, on a business growing 0.6%. Calling it a 14% FCF yield without naming the leverage is takeaway-vs-data divergence inside our own screen note. Goodwill $7,325M against total equity $3,964M means tangible book is about -$4.9B (disclosed for debt capacity only; book value is irrelevant under the tier-2 frame). Gate test half-true: revenue side correct and understated (FY24 $5,770M -> FY25 $5,168M -> FY26e $5,217M -> FY27e $5,246M: it stopped growing), earnings side wrong (FY26e EPS +2.1% and FY27e +1.4% over 90 days, with 5 upward next-quarter revisions in the last 7 days - EPS grinds up because the share count falls 2.8% a quarter). SBC is genuinely low at ~1.5% of revenue - real software honesty credit. Leverage asymmetry: a 3-turn EV/FCF de-rate costs the equity -46% while a 2-turn re-rate gains +38%. AI position: adopter not capex-levered (EUR105M Cork/Galway agentic-AI build, S3NS/Google Cloud); the entry does not require the AI cycle holding, and the real AI risk - agentic AI commoditising content-services middleware - is not in the frozen 45% house call at all. Top unverifiable: the cloud-vs-perpetual-vs-maintenance revenue split, the one metric that decides value-trap-vs-carry; the 10-K/10-Q was not read.
